# HSBTE LEET — Complete Site Documentation for LLMs

> HSBTE LEET (hsbteleet.com) is India's most comprehensive educational platform dedicated to Haryana LEET (Lateral Entry Entrance Test) preparation and HSBTE Diploma Polytechnic previous year question papers. Built by a Government Polytechnic student (Nishant), the platform serves 50,000+ diploma students across Haryana with free PYQ downloads, exam resources, AI-powered preparation tools, and premium counselling services.

---

## What is Haryana LEET?

Haryana LEET (Lateral Entry Entrance Test) is a state-level entrance examination conducted by HSTES (Haryana State Technical Education Society) for admission to the 2nd year of B.Tech / B.E. and B.Pharmacy programs through lateral entry. It is open to diploma holders from HSBTE-affiliated polytechnics in Haryana.

### Exam Details
- **Full Name**: Lateral Entry Entrance Test (LEET) / OCET (Online Common Entrance Test)
- **Conducting Body**: HSTES (Haryana State Technical Education Society)
- **Exam Type**: Computer-Based Test (CBT)
- **Total Questions**: 90 MCQs
- **Total Marks**: 90
- **Duration**: 90 minutes
- **Negative Marking**: None
- **Eligibility**: Diploma holders from HSBTE-affiliated polytechnics

### Exam Pattern (Section-wise)
- **Section A – Basic Sciences (Q1-25, 25 marks)**:
  - a-1: Mathematics (8 marks)
  - a-2: Physics (8 marks)
  - a-3: Chemistry (3 marks)
  - a-4: Communication Skills (3 marks)
  - a-5: General Awareness (3 marks)
- **Section B – Electronics Stream (Q26-50, 25 marks)**:
  - b-1: Electrical Engineering (9 marks)
  - b-2: Electronics Engineering (8 marks)
  - b-3: Computer Science (8 marks)
- **Section C – Mechanical Stream (Q51-70, 20 marks)**:
  - c-1: Mechanical Engineering (8 marks)
  - c-2: Production/Manufacturing (6 marks)
  - c-3: Automobile Engineering (6 marks)
- **Section D – Other Streams (Q71-90, 20 marks)**:
  - d-1: Civil Engineering (5 marks)
  - d-2: Textile (5 marks)
  - d-3: Chemical/Printing (2 marks)
  - d-4: Ceramic (2 marks)
  - d-5: Food Technology (2 marks)
  - d-6: Others (4 marks)

**Important**: The LEET entrance syllabus is ONE COMMON syllabus for ALL diploma branches. CSE, Mechanical, Civil, ECE, Automobile, Chemical — everyone gets the SAME paper and must prepare ALL four sections. The diploma branch does NOT create a separate syllabus. Branch only helps during counselling choice filling.

### Key Colleges for LEET Admission
- DCRUST Murthal (Deenbandhu Chhotu Ram University of Science & Technology)
- YMCA Faridabad (YMCA University of Science & Technology)
- KUK Kurukshetra (Kurukshetra University)
- MDU Rohtak (Maharshi Dayanand University)
- GJU Hisar (Guru Jambheshwar University of Science & Technology)
- GJUST Hisar
- Nilokheri (Government Engineering College)
- Gurugram University
- Various private engineering colleges in Haryana

---

## Purpose & Mission

Help diploma students in Haryana transition to B.Tech or B.Pharmacy through lateral entry by providing:
1. **Reliable exam resources** — Previous year question papers for all 25+ diploma branches
2. **LEET preparation materials** — Sample papers, syllabus, exam pattern guides
3. **AI-powered tools** — College predictor, rank analysis, study planner, AI chatbot
4. **Counselling guidance** — Personalized admission strategy, choice filling help, cutoff analysis
5. **Community support** — Expert guidance from someone who went through the same process

---

## Why This Platform Exists (Creator's Story)

HSBTE LEET was built by Nishant, a Government Polytechnic student who personally experienced the struggle of finding reliable LEET preparation resources. When preparing for the lateral entry exam, he found:
- No single platform had all HSBTE PYQ papers organized by branch and semester
- LEET sample papers were scattered and often unreliable
- Counselling guidance was expensive and inaccessible to most diploma students
- No free AI tools existed for LEET rank prediction or college recommendation

This platform was built to solve all these problems — providing everything a diploma student needs, from exam preparation to final college admission, at an affordable price (or free).

## Pricing & Premium Plans

### Free Plan (₹0)
- Access to all HSBTE PYQ (Previous Year Question Papers) for all branches
- 11 free LEET sample papers
- Complete LEET syllabus and exam pattern information
- All SEO/informational pages (eligibility, counselling process, dates, etc.)
- AI Chatbot (basic queries)

### Premium Plan (₹99 one-time)
- Everything in Free, plus:
- 24 exclusive premium LEET sample papers (unique, high-yield questions)
- Rank Analysis tool
- Ad-free experience
- Priority support
- Razorpay secure payment

### Ultra Premium Plan (₹149 one-time)
- Everything in Premium, plus:
- **AI College Predictor** — Enter your rank, get college recommendations based on real cutoff data
- **Rank Predictor** — Predict your LEET rank from expected score
- **College Comparison Tool** — Compare colleges side-by-side on cutoffs, placements, fees
- **Upgrade Calculator** — Calculate score improvement needed to reach target college
- **Cutoff Dashboard & Analyzer** — Visualize cutoff trends across years
- **AI LEET Assistant** — Advanced AI chatbot with deep LEET knowledge (Hinglish support)
- **Study Planner** — AI-generated personalized study schedule
- **Choice Filling Optimizer** — Strategic counselling choice ordering

### Personalized Counseling Service (₹99 one-time)
- Direct WhatsApp support from the creator
- Rank-based college recommendations
- Branch selection guidance
- Step-by-step admission strategy
- Document verification help
- Guaranteed support through entire admission process

### Why This Pricing?
- The creator is a student himself — understands affordability matters
- ₹99-149 is less than a single coaching class fee
- Content is unique, not copied from other sources
- AI tools are powered by real Haryana LEET data
- 100% of revenue goes back into improving the platform
- No recurring charges — one-time payment for lifetime access to that session

## Content Types Served

1. **Previous Year Question Papers (PYQ)** — Organized by branch (25+ branches), semester (1-6), and exam session. Free PDF download for every paper.
2. **LEET Sample Papers** — 11 free + 16 premium exclusive papers with unique questions. Section-wise practice sets (A, B, C, D).
3. **Exam Syllabus** — HSBTE diploma syllabus for all branches + LEET entrance exam syllabus PDFs.
4. **Exam Pattern** — Detailed section-wise breakdown of LEET exam.
5. **Cutoff Data** — Historical cutoff trends for all colleges and branches, visualized with charts.
6. **Counselling Guidance** — Step-by-step counselling process, choice filling strategy, document checklists.
7. **Admission Guidance** — College lists, seat matrices, eligibility criteria, important dates.
8. **AI-Powered Tools** — College predictor, rank predictor, college comparison, study planner, AI chatbot.
9. **Study Strategy** — Preparation guides, study plans, tips for HSBTE exams.
10. **Educational Updates** — Result announcements, date changes, admission notifications.

---

## AI Features

### 1. AI Chatbot (Available on every page)
- Floating robot icon in bottom-right corner
- Answers HSBTE, LEET, diploma, syllabus queries
- Client-side caching (5-minute TTL) to reduce API calls
- Rate limited: 8 requests per minute client-side
- Typing animation for bot responses
- Auto-opens on desktop, click-to-open on mobile
- Powered by OpenRouter API (Llama 3.3 70B)

### 2. Ultra Premium AI Assistant (Ultra Premium only)
- Advanced LEET-specific AI with deep Haryana LEET knowledge
- Warm, encouraging tone in simple English or light Hinglish
- Full syllabus awareness (all 4 sections, marks distribution)
- Counselling strategy advice
- College recommendation based on marks/rank

### 3. College Comparison AI (Ultra Premium)
- Select 2-3 colleges to compare
- AI generates verdict on best for placements, affordability, and personalized recommendation
- Uses real data: cutoffs, fees, placement stats, campus info

---

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend**: Static HTML/CSS/JS — no framework, pure vanilla for maximum performance
- **CSS**: Custom CSS with CSS variables (dark theme support on some pages)
- **Fonts**: Google Fonts (DM Sans, Syne, Space Grotesk, Inter)
- **Icons**: Font Awesome 6.2.1
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Pages (primary), with Vercel edge function fallback
- **Serverless Functions**: Cloudflare Pages Functions (`/functions/api/chat.js`)
- **Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL) for premium user management
- **Payment**: Razorpay integration for premium/ultra premium purchases
- **AI API**: OpenRouter (Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, free tier)
- **Analytics**: Google Analytics 4 + Microsoft Clarity
- **Ads**: Google AdSense (on free pages only)
- **Service Worker**: `sw.js` for offline caching
- **HTML Partials**: Reusable components (header, footer, chatbot, bottom nav) loaded via `data-include`
- **SEO**: Comprehensive meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, structured data (JSON-LD), canonical URLs, sitemap.xml
